description: Final features, done LAST: the custom agent (manual learning, NO stable-baselines3) for robot 'agente propio', its integration into the experiments and plots as a 4th algorithm, the Webots .wbt controller wiring, a race-mode winner detector, and the README documenting how to run inside Webots. Depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003.
steps: Create controllers/custom_agent/custom_agent.py: robot 'agente propio', a clean documented discretized tabular Q-learning loop reusing DarwinRaceEnv (no stable-baselines3). Discretize the 5-dim observation into bins, maintain a Q-table, epsilon-greedy action selection, TD update; train mode runs episodes and persists the Q-table (e.g. models/custom_qtable.npz), race mode loads it and acts greedily. Mark clearly in Spanish comments 'reemplazar con el algoritmo del Taller 2' with a TODO and an explicit extension point (a strategy method that can be overridden).

Edit experiments/run_experiments.py to add the custom algorithm as a 4th entry in the config generator and runner, and edit experiments/plot_results.py so the summary table and figures include the custom algorithm alongside PPO/DQN/A2C.

Edit pista_atletismo_50m.wbt: change ONLY the controller field of each robot block: DQN -> "dqn_agent", ppo -> "ppo_agent", 'actor - critic' -> "a2c_agent", 'agente propio' -> "custom_agent". Do NOT change translation, rotation, name, supervisor, selfCollision, or any track/barrier geometry.

Add a race-mode entry point (controllers/darwin_common/race.py or a function in agent_runner) that, given the 4 robots' positions each tick, detects which robot first crosses the finish line y=GOAL_Y and reports the winner name. Make the detection logic unit-testable against the mock backend.

Create README.md (Spanish ok) documenting: creating the Python env and `pip install -r requirements.txt`, that Webots is already installed and must be launched by the user, how to set MODE=train per controller to train each agent, how to run the experiments and plotting scripts, and how to run MODE=race for the final competition, plus the note that the custom agent is a Taller-2 placeholder.

Create/extend tests: tests/test_custom_agent.py (tabular agent trains a few episodes on the mock env, Q-table updates, run_race returns metrics), a winner-detection test against the mock, and a .wbt sanity test asserting exactly the 4 controller fields changed to the folder names and no geometry lines changed.
acceptance_criteria: `python3 -m pytest tests/ -q` — the FULL suite passes (SB3/tensorflow/matplotlib-dependent tests skip cleanly if those libs are absent).
custom_agent.py uses no stable-baselines3 import and its Q-table changes after training on the mock env.

pista_atletismo_50m.wbt has exactly four controller fields set to dqn_agent/ppo_agent/a2c_agent/custom_agent and every robot/track/barrier translation, rotation, and geometry value is byte-identical to before (verifiable via git diff showing only controller lines).
The winner detector returns the name of the first robot to cross y=GOAL_Y in a mocked scenario.
README.md documents the full train -> experiments -> plot -> race workflow and names what the user runs inside Webots.

findings:
DONE & GREEN. Full suite `python3 -m pytest tests/ -q` = 51 passed (.venv with sb3/pandas/matplotlib, and system python3). The 14 new tests use only numpy+stdlib so they do not need importorskip; SB3/pandas/matplotlib tests keep their importorskip guards. Verification: wbt diff grep prints nothing (file is UNTRACKED in git, so git diff is empty -> trivially 'only controller lines'); grep -c of the 4 controller folder names = 4.
=== custom_agent (controllers/custom_agent/custom_agent.py) ===
- Agente propio = Q-learning tabular MANUAL, NO importa stable_baselines3 (AST-checked in test). Class TabularQLearningAgent(n_actions, obs_low, obs_high, bins=6, alpha=0.1, gamma=0.99, epsilon=1.0, epsilon_min=0.05, epsilon_decay=0.99, seed=0). discretize(obs)->int (positional base-`bins` encoding, bins**5=7776 states). select_action(state, greedy) epsilon-greedy; update(s,a,r,s',done) TD; decay_epsilon(); save/load .npz; predict(obs, deterministic) returns (action, None) so agent_runner.run_race works unchanged (duck-typed like an SB3 model).
- build_agent(env, **kw), train_agent(env, episodes, agent=None, save_path=None) -> trained agent. Modes via agent_runner.get_mode(): train -> train_agent -> models/custom_qtable.npz; race -> TabularQLearningAgent.load -> run_race. Taller-2 placeholder clearly marked (Spanish 'reemplazar con el algoritmo del Taller 2' + TODO(taller-2)); extension point = class CustomAgentExtensionPoint(TabularQLearningAgent) to override select_action/update.
=== IMPORT GOTCHA (important for later work) ===
- `import custom_agent` was shadowed by the namespace package dir controllers/custom_agent/ (dir on 'controllers' path, no __init__). FIX: pytest.ini pythonpath now starts with `controllers/custom_agent` so the .py module wins over the namespace pkg: `pythonpath = controllers/custom_agent . controllers controllers/darwin_common`. run_experiments.py prepends the same dir (insert(0) last => first in sys.path). Same pattern needed if any other controller module (ppo_agent.py etc.) ever gets imported directly.
=== experiments integration ===
- run_experiments.py: ALGOS now ('PPO','DQN','A2C','CUSTOM'); added SB3_ALGOS=('PPO','DQN','A2C'); ROBOT_BY_ALGO['CUSTOM']='agente propio'; HYPERPARAMS['CUSTOM']=({alpha:0.1,epsilon_decay:0.99},{alpha:0.2,epsilon_decay:0.95}). generate_configs() now 108 (4 algos x 27). run_config() branches: SB3_ALGOS -> MlpPolicy as before; else _train_custom(env, timesteps, hp) imports custom_agent, episodes=max(1, timesteps//64), build_agent(seed=0,**hp)+train_agent, then run_race. CSV schema unchanged (groupby('algo') generalizes). plot_results.py _bar_figure palette extended to 4 colors (added #C44E52). Verified: --quick writes 4 rows (A2C/CUSTOM/DQN/PPO); plot_results renders 4-bar PNGs + summary.
=== .wbt wiring (pista_atletismo_50m.wbt) ===
- Changed ONLY the 4 `controller` fields: DQN->dqn_agent, ppo->ppo_agent, 'actor - critic'->a2c_agent, 'agente propio'->custom_agent (were all '<none>'). No translation/rotation/name/supervisor/selfCollision/geometry touched. NOTE: the .wbt (and requirements.md) are UNTRACKED in git (user input files, never committed), so the git-diff verification is vacuously empty; the structural tests in tests/test_wbt.py assert the invariant directly.
=== race winner detector (controllers/darwin_common/race.py) ===
- RaceWinnerDetector(goal_y=config.GOAL_Y): .update({name:(x,y)}) returns winner name (first to reach y>=goal_y; ties in a tick broken by larger y). .finish_order list, .reset(). run_race_until_winner(robots={name:DarwinRobot}, max_steps, goal_y, action_fn=walk_forward) ticks all robots and returns {winner, finish_order, steps}. Unit-tested against the mock.
=== tests added ===
- tests/test_custom_agent.py (6): no-sb3-import (AST), q-table changes after training, discretize bounds, save/load roundtrip, run_race metric keys, extension-point subclass override. Uses fake_webots fixture, self_name='agente propio'.
- tests/test_race.py (5): first-to-cross, same-tick most-advanced, default goal=config.GOAL_Y, run_race_until_winner on mock (agente propio starts y=11.99 > goal), progression from y=6.04.
- tests/test_wbt.py (3): exactly 4 controller folders set & no '<none>'; each robot has expected controller; translation + supervisor/selfCollision unchanged.
- tests/test_experiments.py updated: config set now {PPO,DQN,A2C,CUSTOM}; quick configs now 4.
=== CONSTRAINTS RESPECTED ===
- No stable-baselines3 in the custom agent. Did not install/launch Webots. Did not modify requirements.md or any track/robot geometry. README.md documents env-setup -> train (MODE=train) -> experiments -> plot -> race (MODE=race) and what the user runs inside Webots.
